text_block_list.text:
Contenders of the Classic and Senior 
classes gather to compete for the 
prestigious autumn shield—a grand stage 
once a year: The Tenno Sho (Autumn).

However, surely right at this very moment, 
this stage holds an even more special 
meaning for the girls standing in the 
paddock.
King Halo. Special Week. Seiun Sky.

The girls of the "Golden Generation," 
shining with dazzling brilliance. Who 
among them will claim the leading role 
along with the Shield—
